semiconductor_relevance: High — Argal srl specializes in advanced AODD pumps designed specifically for semiconductor applications, ensuring purity and reliability in critical processes.
summary: Argal srl manufactures the QUANTUM-S, a next-generation AODD pump tailored for semiconductor applications. Constructed entirely from ultra-pure PTFE, it is engineered for the transfer of chemicals and solvents, ensuring contamination-free fluid transfer in critical semiconductor processes.
capabilities: AODD pumps for chemical and solvent transfer
